# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMPULSE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

High volume on the opening range that closes near its low signals early seller dominance, predicting a continuation lower. This captures institutional selling pressure at the open that fails to be absorbed by buying interest, likely due to overnight news or order flow imbalance.

## Mechanism

Define opening range (first 30 min) high (ORH) and low (ORL). Calculate average 5-minute volume of prior 20 bars (excluding today). If OR volume > 1.5× that average AND OR close ≤ ORL + 0.2% of ORL, then enter short at the close of the first bar after OR that closes below ORL. Exit: chart-stop at ORH, TP1 at 1R (risk = entry to ORH), runner trails 20% off high-water mark. Regime filters: VIX between 12-22, OR width <0.5% of price, avoid gap-open days >0.8%.
